macros.name: sudokusize
macros.doc: This length contains the size of the grid, defaulting to 10cm.

macros.name: sudokuthickline
macros.doc: This length determines the thickness of the thick lines and defaults to 2pt.

macros.name: sudokuthinline
macros.doc: This length determines the thickness of the thin lines and defaults to 0.4pt.
